Adding NES games
On first launch, choose the folder containing your NES ROMs. OpenNES scans the folder and its subfolders; if nothing is found, choose Rescan or Change folder on the home screen.

Missing games or artwork
Check the ROM filename and file format. Use Library maintenance to refresh missing details, or set a custom cover from a game\'s detail sheet.

Controls and saves
Customize touch controls while playing. External gamepad bindings are in Settings. Save states are available from the pause menu; in-game saves remain separate.

Live NES achievements require an authenticated native game session and an officially recognized ROM. Gameplay tracking is experimental. Website progress below remains view-only.

This fingerprint is calculated on your device. No ROM bytes are uploaded. If you explicitly request website progress, OpenNES sends your web API key and username over HTTPS to RetroAchievements. A fingerprint alone does not confirm support.

Optional: enter your RetroAchievements username and personal web API key to view achievements already earned on the website. This does not sign in the emulator or enable earning achievements. Get your key from your RetroAchievements Control Panel under Keys. The key is stored encrypted on this device.

Tap Start, close this menu, play for several seconds, then reopen Achievements and tap Refresh. Frame count and verified RAM reads should increase, and mapped NES memory should be greater than zero. Stop the probe when finished. This does not earn achievements.

Applying replaces available genre, release year, and description with the selected record. Existing values are kept if the record has no replacement. This cannot change your game ROM, title, artwork, or save data.
